import sys
import math
import time

# Constants
eps = 1e-9
mod = int(1e9 + 7)

# Read input
p, k = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())

# Disjoint Set Union (Union-Find) data structures
snm = list(range(p))
sz = [1] * p

def getroot(u):
    while snm[u] != u:
        snm[u] = snm[snm[u]]
        u = snm[u]
    return u

def merge(u, v):
    u = getroot(u)
    v = getroot(v)
    if u != v:
        sz[u] += sz[v]
        snm[v] = u

def isok(a, b, p):
    res = 1
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            res = (res * a) % p
        a = (a * a) % p
        b >>= 1
    return p if res == 1 else 1

def binpow(a, b):
    res = 1
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            res = (res * a) % mod
        a = (a * a) % mod
        b >>= 1
    return res

if k == 0:
    print(binpow(p, p - 1))
    sys.exit()

for i in range(p):
    snm[i] = i
    sz[i] = 1

for i in range(p):
    merge((k * i) % p, i)

ans = 1
for i in range(p):

        ans = (ans * isok(k, sz[i], p)) % mod

print(ans)
